steps.caption: Profile reinstatement
steps.narration: This is Reinstatement. When Google suspends your Business Profile, you send this request, and our team reviews the case before taking it on.

steps.caption: Initial review: 1–2 business days
steps.narration: The first review takes one to two business days.

steps.caption: Your name
steps.narration: The form asks for your name, and the email where we can reach you.

steps.caption: Your email
steps.narration: Our answer comes to this address.

steps.caption: Business name; website is optional
steps.narration: Then the business name as it appears on Google. The website is optional.

steps.caption: The address, even if hidden
steps.narration: Enter the business address, even if it's hidden on the profile.

steps.caption: Storefront, service area, or hybrid
steps.narration: Choose what best describes the business: a storefront, a service area business, or a hybrid of both.

steps.caption: More than one location? No or Yes
steps.narration: Answer No or Yes: does the business have more than one location? Nothing is picked for you.

steps.value: Suspended two weeks ago, a day after we edited the business name.
steps.caption: Describe what happened
steps.narration: Describe the problem: when it happened, what Google said, and what you've already tried.

steps.caption: Submit sends it to the team
steps.narration: Choose Submit and the request goes to our team. No account and no payment is needed to send it.

steps.caption: How reinstatement works
steps.narration: How reinstatement works lists what happens next.

steps.caption: 1. We review, and say if we can help
steps.narration: We review your case and tell you honestly whether we think we can help.

steps.caption: 4. The appeal, and updates until Google decides
steps.narration: If we take it, we fix the cause and bring the profile in line with Google's guidelines. Then we submit the appeal, and keep you updated until Google decides.

steps.caption: Menu: Google Business, Reinstatement
steps.narration: You'll find Reinstatement in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.description: A one-minute look at Reinstatement in ConstructHUB: the request form for a suspended Google Business Profile, what it asks for, and what happens after you send it: a review of your case, a guideline-first fix, and an appeal written and submitted for you.
